definitions.rule: Unique source-backed nonclosed-to-closed transitions in the activity window, deduplicated across copies; a later genuine close after reopening is another transition. Unknown predecessor or ambiguous ordering excluded and disclosed.

Unique cases with a supported closure in the window, whether closed or subsequently reopened at selected evidence cutoff. Select last supported closure in that window per case. Original receipt to that administrative closure in local calendar days; unknown endpoints excluded/disclosed. Distinct from baseline cases.closed_duration@0.2.0, which excludes still-open cases at selected evidence cutoff.

Eligible open cases at endpoint; local calendar date minus original receipt date (or explicitly selected team basis). Missing receipt dates stay missing. R7 quantiles with N; no average-age substitution.

Each assessed eligible case assigned once by its exact supported set at one taxonomy level; separate cases with no supported membership into assessed-none and unassessed. Additional uncertain memberships disclosed without promotion. Full-level or explicitly selected projection; top K descending count then node-ID order plus union remainder.

Distinct case union per problem and handling pair under an explicit accepted relation type. Cells overlap. Ordered association is not causal impact; operational consequence requires its own evidence. No avoided cost/delay inference.
